title: Tail of a List
required_features: Algebraic finite lists and option-like result datatype
Parametric abstract refinements over zero-based list positions
Boolean measure over the option-like result
semantic_obligations: For every non-empty finite list [x1; ...; xn], return Some xn.
Select the element at final zero-based position len(xs)-1, not merely any member.
Preserve order-sensitive behavior in the presence of repeated values.
Remain polymorphic, pure, deterministic, total over finite lists, and exception-free.

contract_model.input_relation: The abstract refinement p i x states that x is at zero-based position i in xs.
contract_model.nonempty_result: A Just result must satisfy p (len xs - 1) value.
contract_model.empty_result: isNothing result == (len xs == 0), so Nothing is permitted exactly for the empty input.
contract_model.strength_note: The positional relation makes this strictly stronger than a length-only or set/membership contract.

trusted_primitives: Integer arithmetic and equality in Synquid refinements
true and false refined Boolean declarations used by isNothing
